jobs.title: Part-Time & Supply SEN Teaching Assistant
jobs.description:
Job Description

Part-Time & Supply SEN Teaching Assistant

Location: Wakefield

Start Date: September 2026

Hours: Flexible Part-Time & Supply Opportunities Available

Salary: Competitive daily rate / hourly rate dependent on experience

We are currently seeking reliable, enthusiastic and compassionate SEN Teaching Assistants to provide part-time and supply support within a specialist educational setting in Wakefield from September.

The provision supports children and young people with a range of Special Educational Needs and Disabilities (SEND), including Autism Spectrum Condition (ASC), communication and interaction difficulties, moderate to severe learning difficulties, sensory needs, and social, emotional and mental health (SEMH) needs.

This is an excellent opportunity for individuals looking for flexible work while making a genuine difference to the lives of pupils who require additional support to access education and achieve their potential.

The Role

As a Supply SEN Teaching Assistant, you will:

  • Provide classroom, small group and 1:1 support to pupils with SEND.
  • Assist teaching staff in delivering engaging learning activities.
  • Support pupils' communication, emotional regulation and social development.
  • Promote positive behaviour and engagement in learning.
  • Adapt to different classes and age groups as required.
  • Help create a safe, nurturing and inclusive learning environment.
  • Support pupils with personal care where necessary.

Requirements

We are looking for candidates who:

  • Have previous experience supporting children or young people with SEND.
  • Ideally have experience working within a specialist SEND school or alternative provision.
  • Have knowledge of autism, communication needs and learning difficulties.
  • Are caring, patient and resilient.
  • Can build strong professional relationships with pupils and staff.
  • Are flexible and comfortable working in different classroom settings.
  • Hold an enhanced DBS on the Update Service or be willing to obtain one.

Why Apply ?

  • Flexible working patterns to suit your availability.
  • Opportunity to gain experience within a specialist SEND setting.
  • Supportive and welcoming staff team.
  • Rewarding work that has a real impact on pupils' lives.
  • Ongoing opportunities throughout the academic year.

Whether you're an experienced SEN Teaching Assistant, a support worker with relevant experience, or someone looking to build a career within specialist education, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today to secure flexible SEN support work for September.

jobs.title: Part-Time HR Coordinator
jobs.description:
Job Description

Job Specification - Part-Time HR Coordinator Location: Leeds, Yorkshire Industry: HVAC Installation, Servicing & Maintenance / Building Services Position: HR Coordinator Employment Type: Part-time Role Overview We are looking for an organised, proactive and personable Part-Time HR Coordinator to join our established and growing HVAC and building services business in Leeds. The company specialises in HVAC installation, servicing and maintenance, supporting commercial and building services projects across the region. This is a hands-on HR coordination role supporting both our office-based team and engineers working across customer sites. The successful candidate will take ownership of day-to-day HR administration while supporting recruitment, onboarding, employee records, training, compliance and general employee matters. Key Responsibilities HR Administration Maintain accurate and confidential employee records. Manage personnel files, employment documentation and HR records. Prepare contracts, offer letters and other HR correspondence. Maintain holiday, sickness and absence records. Monitor probation periods and key employee dates. Assist with employee reviews and HR processes. Keep HR systems and databases up to date. Ensure HR documentation is completed accurately and on time. Maintain confidentiality when dealing with employee information.Recruitment Coordinate recruitment for HVAC engineers, service engineers, maintenance engineers, apprentices and office-based positions. Prepare and advertise job vacancies. Manage applications and shortlist suitable candidates. Arrange interviews with managers. Communicate with candidates throughout the recruitment process. Coordinate references and right-to-work checks. Assist with pre-employment checks and documentation. Maintain a pipeline of potential candidates for future vacancies. Onboarding & New Starters Coordinate the complete new-starter process. Prepare employment documentation and starter packs. Arrange inductions. Ensure new employees receive company policies and procedures. Coordinate required training and competency checks. Ensure engineers have the appropriate documentation, qualifications and certifications before commencing work. Monitor probation periods and provide reminders to managers. Training & Competency Records Because we operate within the HVAC and building services sector, maintaining accurate training and competency records is an important part of the role. Responsibilities will include: Maintaining training and qualification records. Monitoring expiry dates for relevant certificates. Booking refresher training where required. Liaising with training providers. Supporting managers with employee training requirements . Maintaining records for technical, health & safety and industry-related qualifications. Ensuring managers are alerted to upcoming certification renewals.Employee Support Act as a first point of contact for routine HR queries. Provide employees with information on company policies and procedures. Support managers with employee-related matters. Assist with absence and attendance processes. Support employee engagement initiatives. Help maintain a positive and professional workplace culture. Escalate more complex HR or employee relations matters appropriately.Payroll & Administration Support Assist with the preparation and checking of payroll information. Maintain accurate records of holidays, sickness, overtime and other relevant information. Liaise with payroll providers or the finance team. Assist with payroll queries where appropriate. Maintain accurate employee information for payroll purposes. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity in our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status

jobs.title: Part Time - SEN Support
jobs.description:
Job Description

Part Time - SEN Support

Type: Part Time, Bank Staff, Supply Cover, Shift Work

Location: Leeds

The Job:

  • Day to day and part time work available around your other commitments
  • Working across different schools, settings and learners
  • Gaining valuable experience across educational sites (Ideal for current graduates)

Veritas Education are looking to expand their ever-growing special educational needs supply staffing team across the Leeds area. Veritas work with a range of special educational needs schools, complex needs sites and mainstream school provisions.

The role of a supply/bank staff member will be….

  • Working across a range of different schools on a week-by-week basis
  • Supporting across different classes, age groups and special educational needs
  • Confident and showing pro-activity, working in different classes and with new learners each day, providing a nurturing and safe school environment
  • Open to pre-arranged work and last-minute emergency cover calls
  • Comfortable working across different learning, physical, medical and SEMH/Behavioural needs.

This role is ideal for any current university students looking to pick up extra work around their studies relevant to their course, applicants with other jobs who need flexibility or someone who is looking to take that first step into school roles and gain valuable experience into educational settings!

Please apply to the role direct, or email a copy of your CV over to
